steps.what: List the suspected violation facts already in the file.
Interview the individuals and obtain the evidence.
Write what the interview shows about the violation.

tasks.design: Facts already in {DOCS} are listed before the interview so the inspector does not rely on memory. The interview of individuals, and the evidence obtained, stay with the inspector. The written note says only what the interview showed. A fact list is not evidence.
tasks.previous_blocker: Interviews started from a thin complaint, and the note was written that evening from memory.
tasks.enabler_now: The facts already stored can be listed before the conversation.
tasks.still_hard: A person who contradicts the file, and evidence the file did not mention.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector can hear that a stored fact is not what happened.
tasks.altitude: The known facts are listed before the interview. The inspector still conducts it. The list is not treated as evidence.

reach.task: Read the file before interviewing a person about what happened.
reach.learn: The file can be listed. The interview still happens here.

evidence.claim: Facts already in the file can be listed before an interview. The interview itself cannot be replaced by that list.
The site visit, the sample, and the interview stay with the inspector. A stored reading is not a finding. A label is not a sample.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An environmental inspector in a mid-size European organisation. National permit rules apply. A list does not issue a notice or allow a discharge.
Fields: Case id and fact id, produced by the case file. A case with no fact id is not given a prepared list. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the inspector finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the case file the organisation already keeps. A new store of named individuals needs works-council consent before it is switched on.
unknowns: Who may be interviewed without another officer present.
research_questions: What share of cases already have stored facts?
Which interviews are always done in person?

already_counted.description: The inspector still interviews and obtains the evidence.
The inspector still writes what the interview shows.

incremental.description: The inspector adds a fact the list did not contain.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is listing facts already in the file. It disappears when the case has no stored facts and the inspector prepares from the papers. The interview time is unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Explain findings and how to correct them.

steps.what: Assemble the pollution control regulations cited in the finding.
Inform the group and explain how the problem is corrected.
Note the inspection findings the inspector actually explained.

tasks.design: The pollution control regulations cited in the finding are assembled from {DOCS} before the meeting. The inspector informs the individuals or the group and explains how the problem can be corrected. The note records the inspection findings that were actually explained. A regulation that is not in the file is not handed out.
tasks.previous_blocker: Explanations relied on a regulation printout that was not the version cited in the finding.
tasks.enabler_now: The cited text can be assembled from the file before the meeting.
tasks.still_hard: A problem the regulation does not correct, and a group that needs a different explanation.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector can tell when a correct quotation does not help this site.
tasks.altitude: The cited regulation is in the room. The inspector still explains the finding and the correction. The extract is not sent as the explanation.

reach.task: Bring the cited rule to a meeting that still has to explain it.
reach.learn: The text can be assembled. The explanation stays here.

evidence.claim: A regulation already cited in the finding can be assembled for a meeting. It cannot explain the finding to the group.
A record is filed only when the required ids are already stored. A drafted sentence may cite only a figure or a rule already in the file. A sentence with neither stops.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An environmental inspector in a mid-size European organisation. National permit rules apply. A list does not issue a notice or allow a discharge.

Fields: Finding id and regulation id, produced by the finding. A finding with no regulation id is not given an extract. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the inspector finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the regulation texts the organisation already stores.
unknowns: Which groups must be told in person.
Who else may explain a finding.
research_questions: What share of findings cite a stored regulation?
Which corrections are always agreed on site?

already_counted.description: The inspector still explains the finding and the correction.
The inspector still notes what was explained.

incremental.description: The inspector adds a correction the extract did not cover.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is assembling the regulation already cited. It disappears when the finding cites nothing and the inspector searches the texts. The explanation stays with the inspector.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Verify hazardous chemical handling and storage.

steps.what: List the storage rules for the named hazardous chemical.
Verify chemicals are handled, stored, and disposed of correctly.
Record whether the storage meets the regulations.

tasks.design: Storage rules for a named hazardous chemical are listed from {DOCS} when the substance id is in the file. The inspector verifies on site that the chemicals are handled, stored, and disposed of as the regulations require. A missing substance id stops the list. The list does not verify the store.
tasks.previous_blocker: The inspector carried a general chemical sheet and matched it to the label by eye.
tasks.enabler_now: The rules for a named substance can be listed before the walk.
tasks.still_hard: A container with no readable name, and a disposal path the rule does not cover.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector can see a labeled drum that is not stored as the rule requires.
tasks.altitude: The rule for a named substance is open on site. The inspector still verifies the handling, storage, and disposal. An unnamed container is not checked by the list.

reach.task: Check a store against the rule for the named substance.
reach.learn: The rule can be listed. The store is still walked here.

evidence.claim: Storage rules for a named substance can be listed from the file. The list cannot verify how the chemical is handled on site.
The site visit, the sample, and the interview stay with the inspector. A stored reading is not a finding. A label is not a sample.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An environmental inspector in a mid-size European organisation. National permit rules apply. A list does not issue a notice or allow a discharge.

Fields: Substance id and rule id, produced by the substance register. A container with no substance id is not given a rule list. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the inspector finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the substance rules the organisation already stores.
unknowns: Which substances are in scope this year.
Who may enter a store with the inspector.
research_questions: What share of containers have a substance id?
Which disposals are always checked in person?

already_counted.description: The inspector still verifies handling, storage, and disposal.
The inspector still records whether the storage meets the rules.

incremental.description: The inspector looks up a substance the register did not name.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is the rule list for a named substance. It disappears when the container has no substance id and the inspector identifies it. The store check stays with the inspector.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Learn the safety rules and spot unsafe conditions.

steps.what: Open the current safety rules and precautions.
Observe the site and recognize unsafe conditions.
Record the safety protocol the inspector will implement.

tasks.design: The current safety rules and precautions are opened from {DOCS} for the site type. The inspector observes the site, recognizes unsafe conditions, and decides the protocol to implement. The sheet does not score the inspector and does not declare a condition safe. A site type with no sheet is inspected from the rules the person already knows.
tasks.previous_blocker: Safety sheets were an old print, and the note of unsafe conditions was written after leaving the site.
tasks.enabler_now: The current sheet can be the one opened.
tasks.still_hard: A condition the sheet does not name, and a protocol that does not fit the site.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector can see an unsafe condition a current sheet does not list.
tasks.altitude: The current sheet is open. The inspector still observes the site and still chooses the protocol. No score is stored.

reach.task: Use the current site rule while still looking at the place.
reach.learn: The sheet can be current. The observation stays here.

evidence.claim: The current safety sheet can be opened for a site type. It cannot observe the site or recognize an unsafe condition.
EU AI Act Annex III 4(b) and works-council consent cover assigning work by performance. This task stores no skill score.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An environmental inspector in a mid-size European organisation. National permit rules apply. A list does not issue a notice or allow a discharge.
Fields: Site type id and rule id, produced by the safety sheet. A site type with no rule id is not given a sheet. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the inspector finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the safety rules the organisation already keeps. This task stores no skill score.
unknowns: Which site types have a current sheet.
Who confirms a protocol was implemented.
research_questions: How often the safety sheet changes?
Which conditions are always judged on site?

already_counted.description: The inspector still observes the site and recognizes unsafe conditions.
The inspector still records the protocol.

incremental.description: The inspector notes a condition the sheet did not name.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is opening the current safety sheet. It disappears when the site type has no sheet and the inspector uses the paper set. Observing the site and recognizing unsafe conditions stay with the inspector.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The inspector still interviews, still explains the finding, and still checks the chemical store. A rule already in the file can be open before that work, and it does not verify the site.
reach: Regulatory affairs specialists explain a rule that is already written down, and this job learns the explanation to a site is still a conversation.
Government property inspectors check a store against a named rule, and this job learns the walk through the store stays with the person.
skills_to_grow: Separate a rule that is already in the file from a finding that is not.
Recognise an unsafe condition without turning the visit into a score.
role.ambitious_version: The cited rule is open before the conversation or the store check, and the inspector still makes the finding on site.
